inputs: Frozen snapshot.build_steps with REQUIREMENTS set to main guest dependencies; frozen CLI pins and recipe constants unchanged. The home step names the microVM's own home, /opt/guildbotics/home, instead of the frozen host's "$HOME" (#107). The node, npm, grok and antigravity steps and the names follow the current CLI and Node.js pins (update-dependencies).

steps.label: pdf
steps.script:
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpango-1.0-0 libpangoft2-1.0-0 libharfbuzz-subset0 fontconfig fonts-dejavu-core fonts-noto-cjk
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

steps.label: node
steps.script:
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) platform=linux-x64 sha256=061ec3e3062115705b56b51fa9cc330ab50d34b6969387d4e4b1a50c6809acc2 ;;
  aarch64) platform=linux-arm64 sha256=261af2af250dfd7e9f25cf151d1b2713a0adf8f10a9ad116c4947f68627affe8 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.3/node-v24.22.3-$platform.tar.gz" -o /tmp/node.tar.gz
echo "$sha256  /tmp/node.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm /usr/local/lib/node_modules/corepack
tar -xzf /tmp/node.tar.gz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner "node-v24.22.3-$platform/bin" "node-v24.22.3-$platform/include" "node-v24.22.3-$platform/lib" "node-v24.22.3-$platform/share"
rm -f /tmp/node.tar.gz
node --version

steps.label: grok
steps.script:
curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | GROK_BIN_DIR=/usr/local/bin bash -s 1.0.77
cp -L /usr/local/bin/grok /usr/local/bin/grok.bin
mv -f /usr/local/bin/grok.bin /usr/local/bin/grok
rm -f /usr/local/bin/agent
rm -rf "$HOME/.grok"
grok --version

steps.label: antigravity
steps.script:
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) platform=linux-x64 archive=cli_linux_x64 sha512=d01eb13ba7750eed18907f1ae8860864371e0ad9064415e8d033d22b4bd7b9b4e4c7f962058520b452d67db1c33163d9a889d55a7dffa159596ec6cd91a87b79 ;;
  aarch64) platform=linux-arm archive=cli_linux_arm64 sha512=16c632a09b81f598f7652bc11180861f9d2ee4408ffa161dadc83b2010de7a9cd055e97b4b46cd01903e35c0e8bf21d8262462ba7c5f168cc6dada9ac3d522c0 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl -fsSL "https://storage.googleapis.com/antigravity-public/antigravity-cli/1.5.9-4515810895593472/$platform/$archive.tar.gz" -o /tmp/agy.tar.gz
echo "$sha512  /tmp/agy.tar.gz" | sha512sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/agy.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin antigravity
mv /usr/local/bin/antigravity /usr/local/bin/agy
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/agy
rm /tmp/agy.tar.gz
agy --version
